description.value:
Your wisdom rivals that of history's greatest Force adepts, granting you several profound benefits.

You become proficient in Wisdom saving throws; if you already had that proficiency, you gain expertise in it instead.

Your keen perception makes you difficult to sneak up on: any creature within 60 feet of you has disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide from you.

As an action, provided you can see and hear, you can sense whether an illusion or other sense-deceiving effect is present within 30 feet of you, though not its nature or location. You can use this feature once, regaining the ability to do so after finishing a short or long rest.
